items.headline: Winfield has 3 TD passes, runs for another score in Ragin' Cajuns' 38-24 win over Coastal Carolina
items.description: — Lunch Winfield threw for three touchdowns and ran for another score to lead Louisiana-Lafayette to a 38-24 win over Coastal Carolina on Saturday for the Ragin' Cajuns third straight win.
